design_evaluation.summary: A polished dark-first personal tech hub with strong hero hierarchy, consistent component styling, working light-theme variant, mobile menu, and a chat consent gate. Main weaknesses are floating widget overlays that collide with content on small screens, truncated text in the terminal mock and stat block, and low-contrast muted text in light theme.
strengths: Clear hero hierarchy: oversized two-tone headline, subtext, stats card, and dual CTAs (Live Feed / AI Lab) read in the intended order in all breakpoints (ui-home-desktop, ui-small-mobile-home)
Tool cards share consistent structure (icon chip, title, description, colored action link: Explore/Scan/Verify/Check), aiding scannability
Theme toggle produces a coherent light variant with consistent brand colors and unchanged layout (ui-theme-toggle)
Mobile menu presents a full-height, well-spaced nav list with the 'Break it' CTA preserved (ui-mobile-menu)
Chat opens with a clear consent gate ('Before we start', disclaimer, checkbox, Agree & Start Chat) and disables the CTA until consent (ui-chat-opens)
Terminal/monitor mock with AI Test Result panel gives a distinctive, on-topic visual centerpiece
issues: Floating Voice Agent / chat buttons overlap content: they cover the '24/7' stat on ui-small-mobile-home and the 'Reliability & Fact Check' card on desktop/mobile-menu screenshots; reserve layout space or reposition
Small-mobile stat block is clipped: '24/7' is cut behind widgets at the fold in ui-small-mobile-home

Terminal mock text is truncated mid-token ('--workers=4...', 'api-endpoints.spec.ts 0.8s') with no scroll affordance; also its first line is partially hidden behind the AI Test Result card in dark theme
Light theme has low-contrast muted text: stats labels ('ARTICLES TODAY') and card descriptions appear washed out against the light background (ui-theme-toggle)
Terms-of-use checkbox label in the chat gate is small with tight letter-spacing, a possible readability/fine-print issue; show focus rings / larger tap target
Icon-only elements (settings gear, close button, floating AI/robot buttons) rely on tooltips not demonstrated; no visible aria/focus indicators in any capture
Rotating stats values (8/3/11 articles, 2 on mobile) suggest live updates but there is no loading/updated cue, which can look like inconsistent state across screenshots
